meta.title: Heartbeat — self-hosted uptime monitor and log viewer
meta.description: Checks your apps every minute, alerts Slack or Discord when one goes down, streams its logs live and publishes a status page for each one. One Rust binary, no database.

features.title: Built for the minute something breaks.
features.lead: Most days it stays quiet. When an app fails, it tells the right people, shows why and keeps your users informed.
f.alerts.title: Alerts that don't get lost
f.alerts.body: Failed deliveries are retried. While an app stays down, a reminder says how long it's been. When many apps fail at once, you get one notice about your own network instead of a storm.
f.checks.title: Checks that fit each app
f.checks.body: Its own interval and timeout, expected status codes, headers, a keyword in the body, TCP for databases, SSL expiry, and JS/CSS bundles for single-page apps.
f.logs.title: Live logs next to the failure
f.logs.body: stdout and stderr side by side, filtered by level and module, searchable, refreshing live.
f.status.title: A status page for each app
f.status.body: 30 days of daily uptime and the notices you publish, without URLs or error messages. Add a badge to a README or embed it in any site.
f.incidents.title: Incidents, measured
f.incidents.body: Every outage with its start, duration and cause, plus MTTR and total downtime.
f.binary.title: One file to run
f.binary.body: Templates and assets live inside the binary, data in plain files. Docker images for amd64 and arm64.
f.security.title: Careful with your network
f.security.body: Checks only call allowed hosts over https, never follow redirects and refuse private IPs. Server-side sessions and CSRF checks.
f.look.title: Your language, your colors
f.look.body: Spanish or English. System, dark, light, or your own theme.

deploy.title: Running in two minutes.
deploy.step1.title: Configure
deploy.step1.body: Copy the example file and set the hosts your apps live on and how admins sign in.
deploy.step2.title: Start it
deploy.step2.body: With Docker, or the release binary behind nginx.
deploy.step3.title: Register your apps
deploy.step3.body: Open it, add each app's health URL, and point alerts at your channel.
deploy.more: Every option, step by step, is in the docs.

tb.meta.title: Theme builder — Heartbeat
tb.title: Give Heartbeat your colors.
tb.lead: Pick the colors, check them on a live copy of the dashboard and paste the CSS into Settings. Everything happens in your browser.
tb.apply.title: Apply it
tb.apply.step1: In Heartbeat, open Settings and find Custom theme.
tb.apply.step2: Paste the CSS or load the .css file, and save.
tb.apply.step3: In the top bar, choose Custom from the theme menu.
tb.apply.note: Only an admin can save the theme. Each person picks Custom in their own browser.
